messages:
emma_fin: Noticed a few customer invoices where revenue allocation reverted to 100% on the previous plan after a mid-cycle plan swap. Example acct=7332 invoice=7810 — Stripe shows split lines, NetSuite has full allocation to old plan. First seen 2026-06-11 02:40 UTC.

ryan_sync: Thanks, digging in. Did we have any DLQ replays or connector restarts during that window?
\ndlq-bot: netsuite-sync: replayed 6 events from DLQ at 2026-06-11T02:37:12Z run_id=run_20260611_0237

ryan_sync: That explains the ordering. Our replay uses standard SQS (non-FIFO) so create/update can arrive swapped. Handler currently replaces allocations blob on update which causes lost merges.

laura_accounting: Estimate of affected invoices? Need $ impact to decide JE thresholds.

ryan_sync: Preliminary query: 14 invoices with allocation mismatch, total delta ~$9,200. Mostly small proration adjustments.

emma_fin: Short term: can we re-run reconciliation to reapply correct splits? Which script?

ryan_sync: Use `tools/alloc_fix --since=2026-06-10 --reason=dlq-replay --dry-run`. It compares Stripe invoice.line_items to NS allocations and outputs a repair plan CSV.

laura_accounting: Approve dry-run. For any repair > $750 escalate for manual JE.

ryan_sync: Plan: (1) deploy quick connector fix to merge allocations by line_id instead of replace; (2) dry-run now; (3) prod backfill 2026-06-11T05:00 UTC with invoice lock during apply.

meera_sre: Ping me if you need a maintenance window. Also recommend adding an alert: any invoice where sum(allocations) != invoice.total -> page billing on-call.

emma_fin: :thumbsup: Keep updates here. Ryan, post the dry-run CSV when ready and include exact invoice list and deltas.

ryan_sync: Dry-run complete: rows=14 total_delta=9198. Sample CSV lines:
``ninvoice_id,delta,reason
7810,320.00,out-of-order-replay
7819,45.75,out-of-order-replay
7832,1200.00,out-of-order-replay
``nI'll queue the prod run after canary validation.
